title: AI learns to predict how proteins fold inside your cells
title_candidates: How Anthropic's AI is designing new drugs before they reach a lab
Anthropic built an AI that predicts what a gene mutation does to your body
The price of drug discovery just dropped because of Anthropic's AI
What biologists are now letting Anthropic's AI do inside their research
The AI your doctor's lab might already be using to design your next medicine
caption:
Anthropic built an AI that helps scientists design new drugs and predict what gene mutations do to your body.

The tools that do this kind of work have always existed, but they were expensive and hard for most labs to afford to run at scale. Anthropic's version brings the same capabilities through Claude at a fraction of the cost, so a biology team can now test thousands of molecular combinations in an AI model before ever running a physical experiment.

The drug that treats something you haven't been diagnosed with yet might be designed this way first.
